## What it catches

Tests importing package internals.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "tests-do-not-import-internals",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^packages/[^/]+/src/internal(?:/|$)"
  }
}
```
